gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-montagu-slab: Edo SZ draws every stroke with one constant width, like a rolling-ball pen moving across the page. And Montagu Slab brings brushed, robust downstrokes and slender turns, which is where the pair finds its warmth.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-noto-serif-hentaiga: Small letters that stand nearly as tall as capitals, with open jaws on each curve, give Noto Serif Hentaigana its sturdy texture. Edo SZ above it stays smooth and unstressed.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-ovo: Ovo is a text serif with gentle modulation and shallow ascenders. Edo SZ pushes against that softness with a lowercase as tall as cast iron capitals and curves that never swell, and that tension is the pair's best quality.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-domine: Eight Bit Dragon strides along with widely separated letters and a towering lowercase, adventurous from the first word. Domine, a serif with compact ascenders and a slight pinch at each joint, gives that swagger a dignified anchor.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-esteban: Eight Bit Dragon stretches its letters wide apart with a towering lowercase. It makes the loud entrance, while Esteban, a classic serif whose thin parts hardly slim down, holds steady with a wide-open e.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-faustina: Widely spaced letters and a towering lowercase make Eight Bit Dragon stride across the line. And Faustina, a text serif with bowls that thin gently, follows with an open-jawed c and capitals barely taller than its lowercase.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-halant: Halant has a faint thick-thin shift, outward-pointing terminals and an x-height like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke. Eight Bit Dragon's relaxed, spread-out stride sets off against that sturdy serif, adventurous beside the traditional.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-hedvig-le: Hedvig Letters Serif shows open-ended curves, a tall sturdy lowercase and medium-key contrast. But Eight Bit Dragon is the one that does the bold, adventurous stepping out, while the classic serif simply carries the text.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-lisu-bosa: Eight Bit Dragon spaces its letters wide and towers in lowercase. Lisu Bosa, a classic serif with counters spilling into the space around them, answers with sturdy, large-looking words and the flex of lightly tempered contrast.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-marcellus: Eight Bit Dragon takes a relaxed stride across widely separated letters, its towering lowercase bold and adventurous. Marcellus SC, a text serif, settles in softly beneath.
